items.title: George Blanchin Interview, 1959-11-13
items.q: I recall, however, one white band... And the only musician I recall... was Snoozer Quinn. I suppose I remember him more than the others because of his deformity.

ctx.x: Are they all colored bands over there?

Well, just about all. I would say 95% of the bands that played for the dancers around Covington and Bogalusa and that section, where I spent my summers in those days, were colored bands. I recall, however, one white band, which was a band from Bogalusa, called Blanchard's Jazz Band. And the only musician I recall, and the only musician I recall in the band was Snoozer Quinn. I suppose I remember him more than the others because of his deformity. Anyone that ever saw Snoozer would never forget him. And I imagine…
What did Snoozer play like then?
